title: Aiko's Birthday Breakfast
setting: A bright family kitchen on a winter morning.

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: Aiko, a young girl with black hair in two small buns

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan, her father, a very tall man with short brown hair in a police uniform

sentences.en: This Wednesday in December is Aiko's birthday.
sentences.zh: 十二月的这个星期三是爱子的生日。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young girl with black hair in two small buns smiles at a snowy window in the bright kitchen, with balloons around her.

sentences.en: Last week she was sixteen; today she is seventeen.
sentences.zh: 上周她十六岁，今天她十七岁了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young girl with black hair in two small buns looks proudly at herself in a mirror, a little older and taller.

sentences.en: At six a.m., she makes breakfast for her family.
sentences.zh: 早上六点，她为家人做早饭。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young girl with black hair in two small buns cooks at the stove in the kitchen while it is still dark outside.

sentences.en: Her new cooking pot is very useful.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young girl with black hair in two small buns stirs porridge in a shiny new cooking pot.

sentences.en: She puts a bowl of strawberries on the table.
sentences.zh: 她把一碗草莓放在桌子上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young girl with black hair in two small buns puts a bowl of red strawberries on the kitchen table.

sentences.en: Her father Dan, a policeman, is two metres tall.
sentences.zh: 她的爸爸丹是个警察，身高两米。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, her father, a very tall man with short brown hair in a police uniform walks into the kitchen and has to bend his head under the door frame.

sentences.en: Dan holds his birthday girl in his arms.
sentences.zh: 丹把过生日的女儿抱在怀里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, her father, a very tall man with short brown hair in a police uniform holds Aiko, a young girl with black hair in two small buns in his arms next to the breakfast table.
